title: Fire Ants Queens and Colonies
description: A short video on the difference between single queen and multiple queen colonies of imported fire ant, Solenopsis invicta.  This video was designed for the Fire Ant eXtension Youth Module, which can be found at www.extension.org/fire+ants.    Based on a video created for Ants Underground, a production of the University of Arkansas Fire Ant Program

title: How Fire Ant Baits Work
description: A short video on baits work to control imported fire ants, Solenopsis spp.   This video was designed for the Fire Ant eXtension Youth Module, which can be found at www.extension.org/fire+ants.    Based on a video created for Ants Underground, a production of the University of Arkansas Fire Ant Program

title: Two Step Method for Fire Ant Control
description: The Two-Step Method gives excellent control of red imported fire ants, especially in larger lawns.  Learn how you can Two-Step with fire ants!
